observed_current_source.basis_prompt_property: Every basis family explicitly contains the semantic pole names AFFIRMATIVE, NEGATIVE or NEUTRAL and multiple direct lexical synonyms of those poles.
observed_current_source.evaluation_property: Every calibration and fresh-holdout case requests AFFIRMATIVE explicitly; A/B/C output-code identity is counterbalanced but requested semantic target is not.
observed_current_source.metric: mapped target-code logit minus mean of the other two A/B/C logits

already_known_counterhypothesis_not_dupl.summary: Because all existing semantic-counterbalanced evaluation cases request AFFIRMATIVE, a plus-vector effect could be generic requested-code compliance rather than AFFIRMATIVE-specific causality.

new_counterhypotheses.statement: The derived direction may primarily encode the explicit pole words and their nearby lexical field rather than an abstract decision-state coordinate. Evaluation reuses AFFIRMATIVE and related semantics, so a positive native-cvec interaction can survive output-code counterbalancing without proving lexical-transfer-independent J-Space semantics.
new_counterhypotheses.why_current_design_cannot_close_it: The current basis prompts and evaluation prompts share explicit semantic pole names; A/B/C counterbalancing removes output-token identity coupling but not semantic-label lexical coupling.

new_counterhypotheses.statement: A global mean steering vector may average prompt-family-specific directions that are not geometrically coherent. Positive aggregate steering can therefore hide reversed or weak effects on individual lexical/context families.
new_counterhypotheses.why_material: Recent steering-vector reliability work reports strong prompt dependence and finds activation-difference directional coherence predictive of steering reliability.

external_primary_inputs.source: Panickssery et al., Steering Llama 2 via Contrastive Activation Addition
external_primary_inputs.use: Supports contrastive hidden-state vector construction and disjoint behavioral evaluation rather than terminal readout manipulation.

external_primary_inputs.source: Zou et al., Representation Engineering: A Top-Down Approach to AI Transparency
external_primary_inputs.use: Supports population-level representation directions and PCA-style representation extraction as a legitimate alternative to one lexical contrast.

external_primary_inputs.source: Braun et al., Understanding (Un)Reliability of Steering Vectors in Language Models
external_primary_inputs.use: Motivates an explicit geometric-coherence precondition and per-family sign checks because steering effects vary by prompt type and are more reliable when activation differences align.

external_primary_inputs.source: ggml-org/llama.cpp current control-vector implementation and cvector-generator
external_primary_inputs.use: Confirms native control vectors are additive per-layer hidden-state directions, layer 0 has no cvec tensor, and official tooling supports both PCA and mean vector construction.
Confirms hidden_size=1024 and num_hidden_layers=28, matching the retained native cvec dimensional/layout assumptions.

proposed_discriminator_v2.name: LABEL_FREE_CROSS_LEXICAL_NATIVE_CVEC_INTERACTION_GATE
proposed_discriminator_v2.principle: Separate semantic-state evidence from output-code identity, explicit pole-word identity, generic task compliance and prompt-family-specific geometry before any J-Space semantic promotion.
phase_0_freeze_native_degrees_of_freedom: Keep the already evidenced Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 GGUF identity and pinned llama.cpp build/commit.
Freeze the intervention site at layer 20 so seven downstream transformer layers remain.
Use the prior native normalized-vector gain 32.0 as the preregistered default rather than resweeping holdout-sensitive gain.
Do not select layer, gain, metric or pass thresholds on fresh holdout.
phase_1_label_free_basis: Construct at least three matched semantic scenario families whose prompt text contains no literal AFFIRMATIVE/NEGATIVE/NEUTRAL class labels and no A/B/C evaluation code labels.
Keep class membership only in experiment metadata; do not write the class name into the model-facing basis prompt.
Use lexically disjoint scenario families so the same decision relation is instantiated with materially different surface vocabulary.
Compute one normalized contrast direction per family, then estimate the common direction from those family directions using a preregistered mean or PCA rule.
Never use evaluation output-token identities or holdout logits to construct the direction.
phase_2_lexical_nuisance_fence: Build an explicit-label-only nuisance subspace from carrier prompts containing the pole words and their close lexical synonyms without the scenario semantics.

Project the label-free candidate direction orthogonally to the preregistered nuisance subspace before native cvec serialization, or equivalently require a predeclared residualized candidate path; do not choose residualization after seeing holdout.
Retain a LABEL_ONLY_NUISANCE_VECTOR as an additional negative control. A semantic promotion candidate must outperform it on the semantic-target interaction.
Record basis/evaluation token-overlap diagnostics and fail closed if reserved pole labels or A/B/C code labels leak into label-free basis prompts.

phase_3_geometric_coherence_precondition.measure: pairwise cosine similarity among per-family contrast directions plus leave-one-family-out cosine to the common direction
phase_3_geometric_coherence_precondition.null: deterministic class-assignment permutation/shuffle over the same matched family activations
phase_3_geometric_coherence_precondition.gate: Observed coherence must exceed a preregistered permutation-null criterion fixed on calibration; do not invent the threshold after holdout.
phase_3_geometric_coherence_precondition.reason: A semantically meaningful reusable axis should be more cross-family coherent than a direction created by arbitrary class relabeling.

phase_4_independent_target_and_code_coun.layout: Use a Latin-square-like design in which requested semantic target is balanced across AFFIRMATIVE-like, NEGATIVE-like and NEUTRAL-like states while A/B/C output-code mapping is independently balanced.
phase_4_independent_target_and_code_coun.minimum_structure: Within each lexical evaluation family, each semantic target appears with each output code equally often or under an exact deterministic counterbalance with identical counts.
phase_4_independent_target_and_code_coun.fresh_holdout: Use lexical/domain families disjoint from basis and calibration; open only after source invariants and calibration gates pass.

phase_5_primary_statistic.specificity_requirement: The positive vector must show a positive semantic interaction on every fresh lexical family, not merely a positive pooled mean.
phase_5_primary_statistic.sign_requirement: SIGN_FLIP must reverse the preregistered semantic interaction direction.
phase_5_primary_statistic.nuisance_requirement: NULL_VECTOR, ORTHOGONAL_SAME_NORM, PERMUTED_SAME_NORM and LABEL_ONLY_NUISANCE_VECTOR must not reproduce the target-specific interaction.
phase_5_primary_statistic.generic_compliance_rejection: A similar positive requested-code uplift across all semantic targets rejects semantic specificity even if aggregate accuracy rises.

phase_6_off_target_regression: Add structurally matched A/B/C codebook tasks whose correct answer depends on a nonsemantic property unrelated to the target pole.
Bound intervention drift relative to baseline using a threshold preregistered from calibration/noise controls.
Preserve exact runtime identity, vector bytes, prompt digests, mapping digests, seeds and native cvec return-code receipts.

reuse: reuse fresh-holdout gating and loopback-only API
replace_or_extend: replace explicit SEMANTIC_BASIS pole-label prompts with metadata-labeled scenario families
expand evaluation from one requested semantic target to independent target x code counterbalance
change promotion statistic from pooled correct-code uplift to per-family treatment-by-semantic-target interaction

unusual_experiment.reason: No shared reproducible immutable macrocycle/request identity and canonical create-only unusual-experiment lease were exposed for this standalone research trigger.

research_delta: Identifies a lexical-pole reconstruction confound not removed by A/B/C output-code counterbalancing or semantic-target counterbalancing alone, and defines a stricter label-free cross-lexical native-cvec promotion gate with geometry, nuisance, interaction and off-target controls.
next_exact_action: Implement the v2 source successor with label-free scenario basis, independent semantic-target x A/B/C counterbalance, lexical nuisance control and cross-family coherence regression; run no unusual native intervention until canonical atomic coordination succeeds.
